q: Will I lose my low first-mortgage rate?
a: Not with a HELOC or home equity loan. Those are second loans, so your first mortgage stays in place. A cash-out refinance replaces your first mortgage with a new rate, term and payment, so it may not be ideal if your current rate is low. We compare both for your numbers.

q: Can rental income from an ADU help me qualify?
a: Sometimes. Some programs count rental income from an existing ADU in limited cases, and some do not. An ADU that is not built yet is a different question. It may not count under every program. [PAT: confirm which of your programs consider ADU rental income or after-ADU value]
